ufo.label: UFO
ufo.sub: UFOs across Britain and Ireland: lights and orbs, craft and objects, and close encounters, each linked to its sources.
ufo.note: Reports are claims as reported, gathered from press, official files (the MoD UFO files at the National Archives), research sites and Wikipedia; the “explained” tag marks cases with an accepted explanation. Several sources for one case are merged into one report.

ghosts.label: Ghosts
ghosts.sub: Ghosts, apparitions, phantom figures and poltergeists, from folklore collections to recent reports, each linked to its sources.
ghosts.note: Folklore entries (corpse candles, phantom funerals, legends) sit alongside modern accounts; dates are given where a source has one. Reports are claims as reported.

cryptids.label: Cryptids
cryptids.sub: Big cats, black dogs, wolf-like creatures, lake monsters and other cryptids, each linked to its sources.
cryptids.note: Big-cat reports include livestock kills and official files released by the Welsh Government and police forces; many sightings are of misidentified domestic animals. Reports are claims as reported.

strange.label: Strange
strange.sub: Time slips, missing time, fairy abductions and everything else that doesn't fit a box, each linked to its sources.
strange.note: A catch-all for odd events: time slips, fairy lore, falls, hums, cunning folk and unexplained happenings. Reports are claims as reported.
